meta.subject: 英文
meta.title: Unit 2 How Do You Go to School?

questions.question: A: How ______ you go to school? B: By bus.
questions.explanation: 主詞是 you，助動詞使用 do。

questions.question: She goes to school ______ bike.
questions.explanation: 交通工具介系詞用 by。

questions.question: They go to the park ______ foot.
questions.explanation: 走路去某地是用 on foot。

questions.question: He goes to school by MRT.
How ______ Tom go to school?
questions.explanation: Tom 是第三人稱單數，助動詞用 does。
